possible_explanations.statement: A high-priced offer or rebid that was accepted for the single interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (interval end local 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST) may explain the one-interval spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect rebid and offer/dispatch logs and unit bid tables for the intervals ending 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z and 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to see whether a high-priced offer was made and dispatched in those intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: A transient change in available local generation (e.g. an output reduction or trip) around the intervals ending 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z–2026-08-06T03:00:00Z might account for the price spike, given dispatch TOTALDEMAND was 1105.32 MW at 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z and net interchange was 63.84 MW export at that interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit-level dispatch/SCADA changes and any outage or trip records for intervals ending 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z and 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to identify sudden output reductions.

possible_explanations.statement: Short-lived export across the interconnector combined with system conditions might have been associated with the spike; the net interconnector flow at the price peak was 63.84 MW net flow out of TAS1 (interval end 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare high-resolution interconnector flow and unit output traces for intervals ending 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z and 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z and review rebids/offers for the same intervals.

uncertainties: No AEMO market notice text was returned for TAS1 in the searched window, so there is no official notice to confirm operational interventions or reported causes.
Unit-level rebid/dispatch records and generator SCADA/outage logs were not examined; these would reduce uncertainty about operational causes.
